highlights: The AI landscape sees significant advancements in specialized models and agentic systems, with new open-source world models and on-device voice agents offering unprecedented capabilities for physical AI and real-time interaction.

Hardware innovations continue to push the boundaries, exemplified by Google's new TPUs designed for long-context agents and confidential inference, alongside a growing ecosystem of developer tools for agent management and multimodal decision-making.

Major tech companies are strategically expanding enterprise AI adoption, integrating foundational models into critical sectors like healthcare and enhancing platform accessibility through partnerships and marketplace availability, while also focusing on AI literacy initiatives.

agents.title: Agent Architecture Cost-Success Trade-offs: A Controlled Evaluation across Enterprise-Style SOPs
agents.summary: This research provides crucial insights into selecting optimal agent architectures for enterprise standard operating procedures, revealing that the 'best' choice is SOP-dependent and that added architectural complexity must justify its cost with significant task success gains. It emphasizes that implementation quality often outweighs the single- vs multi-agent decision, guiding builders toward efficient agent deployment.

agents.title: Embodied Science Agents: Making Embodied Experimental Design Learnable
agents.summary: Introduces Embodied Science Agents (ESA) that unify digital intelligence with physical embodiment to autonomously conduct scientific discovery in self-driving laboratories. ESA enables cognitive, experimental, and embodied learnability, demonstrated by achieving near-complete decolourisation in wastewater treatment experiments, paving the way for advanced scientific automation.

agents.title: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve Automated Research System Beats NanoChat and NanoGPT Records
agents.summary: Baidu's ERNIE Evolve is an automated research system capable of editing code, running experiments, and integrating only verified gains, which has significantly sped up ERNIE-5.5-Flash inference and surpassed public benchmarks on NanoChat and NanoGPT. This demonstrates a major leap in autonomous AI-driven development and optimization.

models.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards
models.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, a single model offering two safeguard levels, featuring 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0, competitive pricing at $8/$40 per million tokens, and a substantial 1M-token context window. This provides builders with a powerful, versatile LLM tailored for diverse enterprise applications with customizable safety profiles.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Ember, a 1M-Context Model for High-Volume Agent Work
models.summary: Meta Muse Ember is a new compact model designed for high-volume agent tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks, and document parsing, offering performance comparable to Claude Haiku 5.5 at approximately one-third of the cost per task. Its 1M-token context window makes it highly efficient for complex agentic workflows, enabling cost-effective deployment.

models.title: MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI
models.summary: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models released PAN 2, an open 29B world model that combines an LLM planner with a diffusion transformer to simulate up to 20 seconds of physical action outcomes as video. This Apache 2.0 licensed model significantly advances physical AI and robotics, offering a foundation for complex simulation and control.

tools.title: Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx: A Dual-Chip TPU and a Confidential TPU
tools.summary: Google introduced TPU 8i Max, packing two TPU 8i chips for long-context agents, and TPU 8tx, which adds hardware confidential inference. These additions to the eighth-generation TPU lineup represent significant advancements in AI acceleration and secure processing for demanding, privacy-sensitive workloads.

tools.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
tools.summary: Google launched the Gemini Decisions API, powered by its state-of-the-art Gemini Decision model, to enable developers to integrate fast, calibrated multimodal decision-making capabilities into their applications. This API facilitates sophisticated real-time choices based on diverse data inputs, accelerating development of intelligent systems.

tools.title: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
tools.summary: Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server specifically designed for AI agents, following OpenAI’s Pando design. It demonstrated robust performance by sustaining 567 pushes per second on a single 8-core server, providing a critical piece of infrastructure for managing and versioning agent-generated code and data.

companies.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
companies.summary: Google Cloud has launched Gemini for Healthcare, a specialized offering designed to unify clinical data and automate healthcare workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burnout and enhance efficiency in the medical sector. This vertical solution demonstrates AI's growing impact on industry-specific challenges.

companies.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
companies.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now accessible through AWS Marketplace, simplifying the procurement process for organizations by leveraging their existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships. This expansion enhances enterprise adoption and integration for large-scale AI deployment, making it easier for businesses to access advanced LLM capabilities.

companies.title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
companies.summary: Google and Adobe are deepening their partnership to integrate creative and productivity tools, enabling users to edit PDFs directly in Google Drive and leverage Adobe AI capabilities within Gemini. This strategic integration streamlines workflows and enhances generative AI access across popular platforms.

learning.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
learning.summary: OpenAI Academy is launching free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops in five U.S. cities, specifically tailored to help caregivers build practical AI skills for everyday life. This initiative aims to bridge the AI literacy gap for a crucial demographic, empowering them with new tools.

learning.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
learning.summary: OpenAI is offering a free year of ChatGPT Plus to over 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members, providing them with advanced AI tools to prepare for civilian careers and enhance their upskilling opportunities. This program supports workforce development and AI adoption for a vital community.

learning.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
learning.summary: Google has released its latest AI Quest, 'Polar Peaks,' an educational lesson focused on neuroscience and mapping the human brain, designed to improve AI literacy through engaging content. This offers an accessible learning path for understanding complex AI applications in scientific fields.
